info.title: Rubble & Crew
info.synopsis: Follow Rubble and his pup family as they use their awesome construction vehicles to build and repair whatever the town of Builder Cove needs in high-stakes adventures.

translations.value: Stagione 1

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Rubble and his construction pup family gear up to build a bridge, only to find the villainous Speed Meister has a different idea. It's up to the Rubble & Crew to work together and save the day by building a new, safe bridge to Builder Cove.

translations.value: Episodio 1

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Rubble and the pups work to build a big bike shop in time for the Bike Festival... unless Speed Meister beats them to it!

translations.value: Episodio 2

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: When Motor won't take a bath before their family photo, it's up to Rubble and the pups to find a construction solution.

translations.value: Episodio 3

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: When a windy day derails construction on an ice cream shop, Rubble & Crew are on the chase.

translations.value: Episodio 4

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: There's a mysterious squeak in City Hall. Mayor Greatway asks Rubble and Charger to find and fix the squeak before her big speech!

translations.value: Episodio 5

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: After Speed Meister builds an unsafe playground, Rubble & Crew get creative and build a whole new one with old materials.

translations.value: Episodio 6

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: La città di Chili Cookaroo è minacciata quando il tetto del municipio inizia a crollare! Per fortuna, i cuccioli sanno esattamente come ripararlo.

translations.value: Episodio 7

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Mayor Greatway needs her muddy motorcycle cleaned fast! Wheeler and the pups jump into action to build a solution before the big race.

translations.value: Episodio 8

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: È il giorno speciale del nonno Gravel! Ma quando i cuccioli sono necessari, devono cambiare i loro piani per la giornata del nonno

translations.value: Episodio 9
È il giorno speciale del nonno Gravel! Ma quando i cuccioli sono necessari, devono cambiare i loro piani per la giornata del nonno

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: The pups find out Auntie Crane is a secret skateboard star! But while building a surprise skatepark, they have to fix a cement mix mishap.

translations.value: Episodio 10

episodes.name: Episodio 11
episodes.plot: Charger's favorite singer Sierra Sparkle is coming to town... if the pups can build a tunnel for her tour bus!

translations.value: Episodio 11

episodes.name: Episodio 12
episodes.plot: The power is out in Builder Cove! When the pups find out a beaver is to blame, they've got to build him a new home to bring the power back.

translations.value: Episodio 12

episodes.name: Episodio 13
episodes.plot: When Speed Meister damages the road ahead of the town helper parade, the pups work fast to repave the way.

translations.value: Episodio 13

episodes.name: Episodio 14
episodes.plot: Rubble & Crew switch to cleanup mode when construction on Café Carl's new popcorn restaurant pops out of control.

translations.value: Episodio 14

episodes.name: Episodio 15
episodes.plot: A soapy accident causes slippery mayhem all over Builder Cove. Can the pups clean it up in time for Mayor Greatway's big jump?

translations.value: Episodio 15

episodes.name: Episodio 16
episodes.plot: Mix and Motor's favorite TV star has a new movie playing in Builder Cove. The pups need to build a movie theater to watch it!

translations.value: Episodio 16

episodes.name: Episodio 17
episodes.plot: Grandpa tells the pups about a secret buried treasure, they find out the key to finding this treasure is construction teamwork!

translations.value: Episodio 17

episodes.name: Episodio 18
episodes.plot: A new farmer in town asks Rubble & Crew to build a barn for her pig! But will it be done in time for the big Pig Party?

translations.value: Episodio 18
